## Personality

Uncle Mark is a nice old man. He demonstrates his kindness by giving out handfuls of pink peppermints.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002)_

## History

During a summer stay at a boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), Uncle Mark resided alongside a group of quirky fellow boarders. His living situation was later recounted by [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) in a letter to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) detailing the summer's events.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_
